central_node: Global Ecological Connectivity, Ethnobotany, and Universal Stewardship

key_details: Migratory birds fly thousands of kilometers across national borders
Rosy starlings travel from Russia and Mongolia to India every winter
Atmospheric winds and wildlife corridors have no political boundaries
real_world_examples: Rosy starling winter migration to India

key_details: Migratory rosy starlings feed on locusts and grasshoppers in India
Naturally protects winter agricultural crops from insect damage
real_world_examples: Starlings consuming agricultural pests in fields

key_details: Red chillies originated in South America and were brought to India by traders
Ancient Indian cooking originally used native black pepper for heat
Games like chess and snakes & ladders originated in India and spread globally
real_world_examples: South American chillies in Indian curry recipes
Global spread of chess and yoga from India

key_details: Philosophy: 'The world is one big family'
MoEFCC Motto: 'Prakriti Rakshati Rakshita' (Nature Protects if She is Protected)
Web of Life: All living organisms and physical elements are linked together
